headline.purpose: Section titles with one lime-accented word.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked metadata: section heads, chips, dates.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Live dots and the nav progress bar.

motion.purpose: Scroll reveals, tilt return, bar fills — the house exponential ease-out.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 22px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .15s ease, background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn .ds-arrow { transition: transform .15s ease; } .ds-btn:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #c5ff36); color: #0a0b0a; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline-bordered secondary action; border and text turn lime on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 22px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-ghost { background: #08090b; border-color: rgba(232,235,228,.16); color: #e8ebe4; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #c5ff36); color: var(--accent, #c5ff36); }

components.name: Credential Chip
components.description: Static pill marking a credential; leading lime dot, never interactive.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: rgba(232,235,228,.58); border: 1px solid rgba(232,235,228,.16); border-radius: 999px; background: #0c0e11; } .ds-chip::before { content: ''; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #c5ff36); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Numbered section link; dim number + label, lime when active via scroll-spy.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: #08090b; padding: 8px; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(232,235,228,.58); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s ease, background .15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #e8ebe4; background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); } .ds-nav-link[data-active="true"] { color: var(--accent, #c5ff36); } .ds-nav-link .ds-num { color: rgba(232,235,228,.36); font-size: 10px; }

components.css: .ds-term { background: #0c0e11; border: 1px solid rgba(232,235,228,.16); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #e8ebe4; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.02) inset; min-width: 280px; } .ds-term-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(232,235,228,.08); background: rgba(255,255,255,.02); } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-r { background: #ff5f57; } .ds-y { background: #febc2e; } .ds-g { background: #28c840; } .ds-term-title { margin-left: 10px; font-size: 11px; color: rgba(232,235,228,.58); letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-term-body { padding: 18px; } .ds-line { display: block; min-height: 1.55em; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-prompt { color: var(--accent, #c5ff36); } .ds-cursor { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 16px; background: var(--accent, #c5ff36); vertical-align: text-bottom; animation: ds-blink 1s steps(2,end) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

components.name: Contact Channel
components.description: Full-width contact row; slides right with a lime gradient wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-channel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px 1fr auto; gap: 20px; padding: 22px 6px; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid rgba(232,235,228,.08); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(232,235,228,.08); background: #08090b; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #e8ebe4; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: padding-left .2s ease, background .2s ease; min-width: 320px; } .ds-channel:hover { padding-left: 18px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(197,255,54,.18), transparent); } .ds-channel-key { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(232,235,228,.36); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-channel-val { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-channel-arrow { color: rgba(232,235,228,.58); transition: transform .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-channel:hover .ds-channel-arrow { color: var(--accent, #c5ff36); transform: translateX(4px); }

narrative.overview: The site is a running machine the visitor is logged into. It boots, it has a shell you can actually type into, a clock ticking Belgrade time, pulsing status dots, and a cursor that blinks. Nothing is decoration pretending to be a terminal; the terminal artifacts (scanlines, phosphor tint, mono type) frame real interactivity. The playfulness is the proof of engineering skill. The system explicitly rejects the generic template portfolio — no centered hero with icon-card grids, no purple gradients, no stock photography, no sterile corporate white — and equally rejects costume terminals: if an element looks alive, it must actually be running.
keyCharacteristics: Single mono family (JetBrains Mono) carrying the entire hierarchy through weight and scale contrast (800 display down to 400 body).
One saturated accent — phosphor lime #c5ff36 — on a near-black, green-tinted neutral field (Committed color strategy).
Flat surfaces separated by hairline borders; depth comes from glow, not shadow.
Ambient motion everywhere, but every loop respects calm mode, prefers-reduced-motion, and pauses when the tab hides.
The accent and font are user-tweakable at runtime; the system must look right under any accent hue.

rules.name: The Phosphor Rule
rules.body: Pure #fff and pure #000 are forbidden. Every neutral is tinted toward the green phosphor family (#e8ebe4 / #08090b).

rules.name: The Live Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent is a variable, not a color. Always var(--accent); derive tints with color-mix. A hardcoded #c5ff36 in CSS breaks the Tweaks panel contract (SVG art is the one tolerated exception).

rules.name: The Alert Exception
rules.body: Alert Red (#ff5d4d) appears only for errors (shell 'command not found') and the red traffic-light dot. It never decorates.

rules.name: The One Font Rule
rules.body: A second typeface family is prohibited. If hierarchy fails, push weight and size further apart (≥1.25 scale ratio), don't add a font.

rules.name: The Tracking Slope Rule
rules.body: Tracking is negative and proportional to size: -0.055em at display, -0.04em at headline, ~0 at body, positive (+0.05–0.08em) at uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Emphasis glows lime; it does not cast gray. If an element needs elevation, give it a hairline border and a background step.

dos: Do use var(--accent) for every lime appearance; the Tweaks panel can recolor the whole site at runtime.
Do give every new animation a calm-mode gate, a prefers-reduced-motion kill, and inclusion in the body[data-paused] pause net.
Do keep every interactive target ≥44px on touch and reachable without hover.
Do carry hierarchy with weight and scale inside JetBrains Mono (800/700/600/400; ≥1.25 ratio between steps).
Do keep sections numbered (01–06) and renumber consistently when inserting one.
donts: Don't use cyan, the Outfit font, or a light theme — PRODUCT.md names all three as fixed anti-references.
Don't build generic template portfolio patterns: centered icon-card grids, purple gradients, stock photography, buzzword copy.
Don't use pure #fff/#000 (The Phosphor Rule) or gray drop shadows for emphasis (The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule).
Don't add gradient text, side-stripe borders, or glassmorphism cards; the only blur in the system is the nav and Konami backdrop.
Don't render fake terminal content. A prompt that can't type is costume; every live-looking element must actually run.
